title: Idle Grounds islands
source: Source of truth for the Hub's Islands tab. Positions: Assets/_Project/Data/Source/game-data.json WORLD.islands (7 built) and docs/adr/0007-island-requesters.md section 2 (the rest, and Celestial's move north). Tributes, NPCs and requests: ADR 0007 sections 1, 3 and 4 (quantities are first guesses until the playthrough bot tunes them).

statusMeaning.built: In the game today (Celestial is built but moves north under ADR 0007).
statusMeaning.planned: Designed in ADR 0007, not built yet.

shrine.name: Sky-Bridge Shrine
shrine.note: Fixed, indestructible 5x5 building on the Center's north edge (local column 44, row 1). Click it, feed the next Island's Tribute by right-click in installments; a full Tribute raises a Sky Path to that Island. Celestial's Sky Path starts at the Shrine.
